sentenceSets.sentence: The appeal of the protagonist's struggle resonated as universal, transcending cultural boundaries and speaking to human experience across societies.

answerChoices.reasoning: Common means occurring frequently; universal emphasizes relevant to or applicable to everyone, which common can be but doesn't necessarily suggest.
Widespread means found or distributed over a large area; universal emphasizes applicable to all without exception.
General means relating to the whole; universal emphasizes applicable to everyone without exception, which general suggests but is broader.
Broad means wide-ranging; universal emphasizes applicable to all without exception.
Popular means liked by many people; universal emphasizes applicable to everyone, not just those who like it.
Global means relating to the world; universal emphasizes applicable to all people without exception.
Comprehensive means including all parts; universal emphasizes applicable to everyone without exception.
Inclusive means including everyone; universal emphasizes applicable to all, which inclusive can mean but broader.
Unique means one of a kind and not universal, the opposite of something applicable to all.
Particular means relating to one specific person or thing, the opposite of universal, which applies to all.
Individual means relating to one person; universal emphasizes applicable to everyone, the opposite.
